result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and traffic signals but lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of streetcar tracks and uneven pavement in the foreground creates additional physical hazards for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway create tripping hazards and can be slippery for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights which may not provide sufficient crossing time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street environment features a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and mixed-use buildings. While sidewalks and basic crossing infrastructure like traffic lights and marked crosswalks are present, the tracks and crossing distance pose risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing and a slip hazard when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings across the main thoroughfare appear worn, reducing visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing crosswalks to high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: If width allows, install a refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a commercial urban street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. A large mobile sign trailer significantly obstructs the corner walkway, and the roadway surface is in poor condition with no visible lane markings.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trailer with an electronic sign is parked on the sidewalk corner, blocking the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner in front of the brick building

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this intersection, leaving pedestrians unprotected while crossing.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and degraded, creating potential trip hazards and poor visibility of the road environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Relocate the mobile sign trailer to an off-street location to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

result.summary: The environment is a typical mixed-use urban street with established pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, zebra crosswalks, and signals. Safety is compromised by the presence of trolley tracks in the roadway and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery and create a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Cars parked near the intersection obscure sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbside near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and increase visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
